# apple_ci_products (Data Source)

Lists the account's Xcode Cloud products. Xcode creates a product when Xcode Cloud is set up for an app or framework.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_products" "all" {}

data "apple_ci_products" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an app, to list only its product.

### Read-Only

- `products` (Attributes List) The products. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the product's app. Null for a framework.
- `created_date` (String) When the product was created.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the product.
- `name` (String) Name of the product.
- `primary_repository_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the product's primary repository.
- `product_type` (String) Kind of product: `APP` or `FRAMEWORK`.
